analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 34.7 continues to consolidate in the neutral zone after exiting oversold. MACD histogram shows improvement (-4275.3736 → -1663.3716), easing bearish pressure. ADX at 33.0 maintains a clear trend, but the 5-day high/low pattern lacks clear direction relative to the 20-day range, suggesting potential consolidation. 52-week position at 15.0% remains low. Expecting consolidation within the 68,045 support and 80,380 resistance levels based on the current price of 69,955.
